shots.description: Exported square cover (1080x1080) with the Sunset Split grade: sample sunset-pier photo, slatted sun, palm silhouettes, NEON VICE title.
The editor at 1280x720 with the sunset-pier sample photo loaded: layout and grade buttons, title and subtitle fields, and per-panel crop sliders.
Exported portrait cover (1080x1350) with the Neon Diagonal grade: magenta and cyan diagonal neon bands over the sample photo.
Exported wide cover (1920x1080) with the Gold Strip grade: gold horizontal bands over the sample photo, two side-by-side panels.
